unresolvedFields.label: Strength 1 — Card Title * Plain-language section title (not a tagline)—8–14 words; include what you do for which owners.
Strength 1 — Supporting Paragraph * Narrative standard (2–4 sentences in ≤500 chars). Proof with numbers, markets, or asset types.
Strength 2 — Card Title * Plain-language section title—8–14 words; distinct from strength 1.
Strength 2 — Supporting Paragraph * Narrative standard. Proof with anchors.
Strength 3 — Card Title * Plain-language section title—8–14 words; often governance, reporting, or partnership style.
Strength 3 — Supporting Paragraph * Narrative standard. Proof with anchors.
Owner Benefit 1 — Card Title * First “why us” card headline—one owner motivation (e.g. governance, speed to value, reporting).
Owner Benefit 1 — Supporting Paragraph * The paragraph under the title: owner outcomes and evidence—not internal job titles. 2–3 sentences (max 500 characters).
Owner Benefit 2 — Card Title * Second distinct reason owners choose you (commercial engine, transition track record, flexibility, etc.).
Owner Benefit 2 — Supporting Paragraph * How that reason shows up in practice—tradeoffs you balance, what the owner experiences. 2–3 sentences (max 500 characters).
Owner Benefit 3 — Card Title * Third reason—often reporting, transparency, risk management, or partnership style.
Owner Benefit 3 — Supporting Paragraph * What owners receive and why it supports their decisions. 2–3 sentences (max 500 characters).
Repeat or Renewal Assignment Rate * % or labeled metric—what you measured.
Typical Management Agreement Length * Years or range—contract-level.
Typical Stabilization Timeline * Months or range from start to stable ops.
Review touchpoints / quarter * Required for your public profile. Formal owner review touchpoints per quarter. Align with Owner Value content if you use it.
Report Types Provided P&L, cash flow, budget vs. actual, etc.
Reporting Systems * Count distinct reporting systems or engines in production—not every report name.
Revenue Systems * Count revenue-related systems you operate (RMS, pricing, channel tools, etc.).
Owner Tools * Count owner-facing tools or portals—dashboards, apps, data rooms, etc.
